text:
Talia (CS): Quick sync / capture from three onboarding calls today. Two consistent asks we should act on: (1) exportable mapping: route -> tokens -> cost (finance needs this), (2) embedding latency spikes that break search UX. Tagging @Ben and @Hana.

Ruth (Onboarding): Saw the same in a mid-market pilot. They literally paused evaluation until they get a CSV they can hand to procurement.

Elliot (AM): In renewal call this morning they said: "we need per-feature line items or we can't justify spend". I can get the invoice and sample data.

signal-bot: New signal recorded: "route-level billing export requested" (id=7002).

Hana (Eng): For embeddings: do we have tenant-specific traces? Could be cache TTL or small batch sizes causing spikes. If it's infra we can temp-fix, if model choice we need product guidance.

Ben (PM): Proposal:
- Immediate (this sprint): produce a CSV export template + one-pager explainer for AMs; run focused embedding perf checks for flagged tenants.
- Roadmap (Q2): console view showing per-route consumption and an embedding latency dashboard + alerts.

Ben (PM): Owners: @Elliot handle invoice sample & comms, @Ruth create AM enablement one-pager, @Hana run perf surface (2-3h). I'll add a triage card and prioritize per-route billing for the at-risk renewals.

Elliot (AM): I'll pull the invoice and draft the CSV mapping today; will add ARR + renewal date to the card.

Ruth (Onboarding): I'll make a 1-slide how-to for AMs and a short checklist for customers.

Hana (Eng): Starting perf runs now. If KV cache TTL is the issue I can propose a quick config change and roll it. Will post results here.

Talia (CS): Added to CS signals board: https://redwood.internal/cs-signals/5312467890. Marked per-route export as P0 for the two at-risk renewals. Please drop links to artifacts in this thread. :white_check_mark:
